name: installed-context-alias
source:
import decimal as d
c=d.Context(prec=9)
d.setcontext(c)
print(d.getcontext() is c)
c.prec=7
print(d.getcontext().prec)
d.getcontext().prec=6
print(c.prec)

name: nested-and-exceptional-parents
source:
import decimal as d
parent=d.getcontext()
with d.localcontext() as child:
 print(d.getcontext() is child, child is parent)
 try:
  with d.localcontext() as inner:
   print(d.getcontext() is inner, inner is child)
   inner.prec=3
   raise ValueError('leave')
 except ValueError:
  print(d.getcontext() is child, child.prec==parent.prec)
print(d.getcontext() is parent)
output:
True False
True False
True True
True

name: copy-and-live-flags
source:
import decimal as d
c=d.Context()
c.flags[d.Inexact]=True
c.traps[d.Inexact]=True
flags=c.flags
traps=c.traps
copied=c.copy()
print(copied is c, copied.flags is flags, copied.traps is traps)
print(copied.flags[d.Inexact], copied.traps[d.Inexact])
c.clear_flags()
print(c.flags is flags, flags[d.Inexact], copied.flags[d.Inexact])
print(c.traps is traps, traps[d.Inexact])
output:
False False False
True True
True False True
True True

name: manager-capture-and-reuse
source:
import decimal as d
parent=d.getcontext()
requested=d.Context(prec=3)
manager=d.localcontext(requested)
requested.prec=7
d.setcontext(d.Context(prec=8))
with manager as child:
 print(child.prec, child is requested, d.getcontext() is child)
 child.prec=4
print(d.getcontext() is parent)
with manager as same:
 print(same is child, same.prec)
print(d.getcontext() is parent)

name: template-install-and-constructor-defaults
source:
import decimal as d
template=d.DefaultContext
template.prec=11
template.flags[d.Inexact]=True
d.setcontext(template)
print(d.getcontext() is template, d.getcontext().prec)
print(d.getcontext().flags.get(d.Inexact,False), template.flags[d.Inexact])
created=d.Context()
print(created.prec, created is template, created.flags.get(d.Inexact,False))
print(d.DefaultContext is template)
output:
False 11
False True
11 False True
True
